'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***The [[European Council]] agrees to donate a billion [[euro]]s worth of ammunition to [[Ukraine]] through an [[European Union|EU]] financing instrument. [https://www.tagesschau.de/newsticker/liveblog-ukraine-donnerstag-225.html (Tagesschau)]
***The [[German government]] approves a request by [[Poland]] for the export of former [[East Germany|GDR]] [[MiG-29]] fighter jets to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/europa/polen-ukraine-kampfjets-103.html (Tagesschau)]
**[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
***In the battle of [[Bakhmut]], [[Armed forces of Russia|Russian forces]] are able to reach the centre of the city, according to [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] and [[Russia]]n sources. [https://www.spiegel.de/ausland/ukraine-news-am-donnerstag-mehrere-russische-regionen-sagen-militaerparaden-ab-offenbar-wegen-sicherheitsbedenken-a-15bb4ac8-3fbe-4ab1-8b24-8be6b8701d23 (Spiegel)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**Four people are killed and 12 others are injured by a series of [[car bomb]]ings during a [[Thingyan]] festival in [[Lashio]], [[Shan State]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/four-killed-several-injured-in-car-bomb-blasts-during-new-year-festival-in-myanmar-582164 (WION)]
*The [[2021 Sudan coup d'état|Sudanese government]] warns of a possible conflict after the [[Rapid Support Forces]] [[paramilitary]] group mobilizes in several [[Sudanese cities]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/13/sudans-army-warns-of-rsfs-movements-in-khartoum-other-cities (Al Jazeera)]

*[[2022–23 Australian region cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Ilsa]] 
***Cyclone Ilsa makes [[landfall]] between [[De Grey, Western Australia|De Grey]] and Pardoo Roadhouse in [[Western Australia]], [[Australia]], as a [[Tropical cyclone scales#Australia and Fiji|category five cyclone]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-au/news/australia/severe-tropical-cyclone-ilsa-makes-landfall-on-was-kimberley-pilbara-coast-as-category-five-system/ar-AA19Pgjp (ABC News Australia)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[2021–2023 North Korean missile tests]]
***[[North Korea]] launches a [[ballistic missile]] towards northern [[Japan]], prompting [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] orders in [[Hokkaido]], before the missile falls into the [[Sea of Japan|sea]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Pentagon document leaks]]
**The U.S. [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] arrests 21-year-old [[Massachusetts Air National Guard]]sman [[Jack Teixeira]] for allegedly leaking [[federal government of the United States|government]] documents to a [[Discord]] gaming group. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/us-officials-identify-leaked-classified-documents-suspect-21-year-old-rcna79577 (NBC News)]
*The [[Uganda People's Defence Force|Ugandan military]] kills notorious criminal Tom Lopusi, who led a massive [[jailbreak]] in [[Moroto District]] in September 2020. [https://english.news.cn/20230413/39ba59d5faa1479d89c61ad9ca7ddfe9/c.html (Xinhua)]
*A 38-year-old tech consultant from [[Emeryville, California|Emeryville]], [[California]], [[United States]], is arrested for killing [[Cash App]] founder [[Bob Lee (businessman)|Bob Lee]] earlier this month. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-65257806 (BBC News)]
*The [[Appellate court|Court of Appeal]] of the [[Moldova|Republic of Moldova]] [[Sentence (law)|sentences]] the pro-Russian oligarch [[Ilan Shor]] to 15 years in prison [[Trial in absentia|in absentia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovan-opposition-leader-gets-15-years-huge-bank-theft-2023-04-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[parliament of Malawi]] approves a new defence act, expanding its [[Malawian Defence Force|Defence Force]] with the creation of a fourth service. [https://www.nyasatimes.com/parliament-passes-new-malawi-defence-act/ (Nyasa Times)]
*The [[government of Bolivia]] calls on the armed forces to tighten border controls in order to prevent the smuggling of state-subsidized [[fuel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-looks-curb-fuel-smuggling-with-help-armed-forces-2023-04-13/ (Reuters)]
